scope: Native terminal error/2 reason-and-arguments wrapper; no catch/unwind admission.
adaptations: Native error_2 allocates {Reason,Args} and sets EXC_ERROR_2 without validating Args. Reserve three words plus existing primitive heap credit before borrowing moving operands, charge the boundary/construction and preserve quota/work/OOM distinctions. Reload the actual argument registers after collection; publish wrapper and exception flags last.

Use the existing terminal exception expansion and monitor-reason stacktrace path. Retain the raw wrapper as a moving root, expose Reason as the error value, use supplied NIL/cons Args for the caller frame, and retain caller arity for non-list Args. Improper supplied lists are not converted to badarg.

Compiled calls, independent OTP traces and a shared-worker spawn_monitor witness cover reason identity, caller rather than error/2 frames, arbitrary argument terms, moving GC, monitor delivery and lifecycle reuse. Primitive allocation/quota/work prefixes check unpublished failure and heap-credit preservation; compiled-call tests separately account for the normal call-boundary credit reset. Catch/try admission and general unwind remain closed.
